algorithm.scope: live causal preparation only; each span's assignment, abstention, and birth uses the margin scheduled at that span's end time
algorithm.provider_state: one production WeSpeakerLiveEvidenceProvider and FingerprintAlbum persist causally across spans
algorithm.sweep_behavior: unchanged production SweepLedger/sweep with deployed margin 0.10; F3 does not alter retrospective policy

development_grid.selection: maximize duration-weighted development speaker accuracy subject to every non-gain gate; deterministic ties choose lexicographically smallest config_id
development_grid.validation_access: selected configuration only, exactly once after development selection
development_grid.rationale: retain deployed 0.10 throughout the short-case class; test only the previously banked 0.15/0.20 long-horizon margins after five minutes

target_error_subset.definition: all cases in each frozen split; no post-result case selection
target_error_subset.score: duration-weighted speaker accuracy over complete reference speaker seconds

preconditions_before_scoring.full_chain_audit: evaluator to candidate input boundary; candidate process sees runtime manifest and decisions only
preconditions_before_scoring.label_perturbation: change evaluation truth labels A,B to A,A; runtime unit shape and complete decision semantic hash must remain identical
preconditions_before_scoring.production_binding_assertion: scheduled wrapper must instantiate the production BoundedCausalIdentityPreparer for every span and may not call assign_speakers directly
preconditions_before_scoring.schedule_activation_red_check: the 30-minute runtime trace must cross every configured time boundary while a short trace remains at 0.10

optimization_budget.pass_1: the complete predeclared three-schedule development grid
